title: Patch: the Drone Battleship as one great ship in three decks
notes: How cards look and how the Battleship moves; nothing plays differently.

player.title: The Drone Battleship
changes: The Drone Battleship's three layers draw as the decks of one ship, with the stack showing as many decks as still stand.
The arrival drops each deck in turn, a hit redirected onto the Shield beams to its dome, drones launch from its bays, the Meltdown core pulses to a blast, and a broken layer shears its deck off.
